subject: Modular compliance packaging & early-adopter incentives
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha@medcentral.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medcentral.com
Date: 2026-10-21T09:18:00Z
Subject: Compliance add-ons — evidence tiers + pricing questions

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked me to follow up with a couple of specifics on the compliance add-ons before we move toward an RFP/PO:

- Audit log retention tiers (we currently need 7/30/365 day options and a way to export on-demand)
- KMS vs HSM: rough monthly economics for a hot-path KMS + optional HSM seats for escrow and attestation
- Data residency: cost delta for US-only vs US+EU (we have a handful of EU clinics)
- Any early-adopter / pilot credits for customers signing before year-end?

I've attached our security questionnaire and a short procurement checklist. Can your team map pricing ranges to the tiers above so we can include in our internal evaluation?

Appreciate it — Asha

[Attachment: MedCentral_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 1.1MB)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Menon <asha@medcentral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T14:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — evidence tiers + pricing questions

Hi Asha —

Thanks for the clear list. We've sketched a concise mapping below to keep the info procurement-friendly; I'll follow up with a term-sheet PDF and a short SOW estimate for the pilot. High-level answers first, then a few clarifying asks: 

1) Audit logs (three configurable tiers)
   - 7-day (hot storage): included with base audit package; no per-GB charge up to 1TB/month.
   - 30-day (hot/warm): additional $0.04/GB-month after first TB. Includes streaming export API.
   - 365-day (cold archive): $0.012/GB-month (S3 Glacier-like). Annual export window included.
   - Export: on-demand exports available via signed bundle; small egress fee applies if outside US region.

2) KMS vs HSM
   - Managed KMS (hot-path): $0.02 per 10k key ops + $400/month per region for key management hot-path SLA.
   - Optional HSM seats (FIPS 140-2 level, attested): $3,200/month per HSM appliance (shared within tenant) or ability to amortize across committed seats.
   - We can structure HSM as an upfront amortized seat or as a monthly pass-through. Common pattern: 12-month amortization to reduce monthly burden.

3) Data residency
   - US-only: no surcharge beyond region ops.
   - US+EU public-cloud regions: +12% surcharge to cover cross-region replication, EU attestations, and separate audit storage.
   - On-prem / VPC private deployments: quote-based (depends on footprint).

4) Early-adopter/pilot incentives
   - Pilot: 3-month pilot with 50% off compliance add-on fees for the pilot term (up to $25k total credits).
   - First-year early-adopter credit: for signed 12-month commitments before 2026-12-31, we can offer a one-time credits package equivalent to 25% of first-year compliance add-on ARR (capped).

Clarifying asks from our side before we generate a formal term-sheet:
- Expected audit log ingest volume (avg GB/day) and retention mix (approx % for 7/30/365).
- Whether you require dedicated HSM hardware or a managed multi-tenant HSM is acceptable for compliance.
- Any EU residency hard-stop dates (do clinics need EU residency immediately or later in rollout?).

I'll attach the term-sheet and a short evidence-delivery playbook (Doc) by end of day tomorrow. If it helps, I can propose a mutual-action plan (MAP) that sequences pilot -> evaluation -> procurement sign-off.

Sofia

[Attachment: redwood-compliance-term-sheet_v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T10:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Compliance add-ons — evidence tiers + pricing questions

Sofia / Jonas —

Looping in to check margin math and an alternative concession framework. Thoughts: 25% first-year credit is straightforward; alternate is to offer an implementation-credit (one-time) in lieu of recurring discount which keeps unit economics cleaner for year-2.

Pricing knobs we should keep in scope:
- Pilot credit cap (protects revenue)
- HSM amortization period (12 vs 24 months)
- Residency surcharge banding (e.g., 8% vs 12% for larger commits)

Jonas: can you back-of-envelope the monthly per-tenant cost of a single HSM vs shared pool? I can then draft a counter that preserves >65% contribution margin.

Ben

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T13:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Compliance add-ons — evidence tiers + pricing questions

Ben / Sofia —

Back-of-envelope: single dedicated HSM appliance OPEX roughly $3,200/month (appliance lease + dedicated infra), shared pool amortized to customers at ~ $1,000–$1,600/month depending on density. If MedCentral expects 2–3 guaranteed seats for SOC2 attestation, amortized 12-month seat at $2,800/month yields ~70% contribution after infra and support costs.

Recommendation: push for either 12-month amortized seats or a higher pilot cap rather than a multi-year full discount. Also include an SLA uplift add-on (priority incident response) as a low-cost attach that protects margin.

Jonas

From: Asha Menon <asha@medcentral.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medcentral.com
Date: 2026-10-27T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — evidence tiers + pricing questions

Sofia —

This looks useful, thank you. Procurement asked for two concrete items to include in the RFP package: 

1) A one-page matrix tying each pricing line-item to the specific evidence/deliverable (e.g., "Audit log export within 24 hours; SOC2 attestation; signed HSM attestation")
2) A proposed commercial table showing: pilot pricing (with credit), year-1 run rate post-pilot, and year-2 list pricing (no discount) so we can run TCO scenarios.

On HSM: MedCentral's security team prefers dedicated HSM appliances for the EU clinics but would accept a shared US pool for US-only traffic. We expect to need 2 HSM seats in year-1 (1 EU-dedicated, 1 US-shared acceptable).

If you can incorporate an implementation-credit (one-time) as Ben suggested instead of a large recurring discount, we can take that to legal quicker. Also — can the early-adopter credit be applied to evidence-delivery professional services (so we can cover onboarding runbook work)? That would be helpful.

Final ask: can you send the MAP + term-sheet with the one-page evidence matrix by EOD Friday so we have time to include in our internal materials?

Thanks,
Asha

[Attachment: procurement_checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)]
